subject: Fix Codex session propagation
description: Implement CODEX_THREAD_ID propagation for Codex MCP/start_task/session claim flow. Add tests proving start_task omits explicit session_id when only CODEX_THREAD_ID is set and still reaches /overlay/status with that session. Keep changes scoped to MCP/session plumbing and docs/tests as needed.

summary: Implemented Codex session propagation through MCP ctx/session inference: shared resolver now reads CODEX_THREAD_ID only for codex client contexts, mcp-graph uses it to populate ctx.session so start_task can omit explicit session_id, and docs reflect optional session_id. Added focused mcp-harness-tools coverage for CODEX_THREAD_ID-only start_task injection and non-leakage to cursor. Tests: node test/mcp-harness-tools.test.js (29 passed, required local-loopback permission after sandbox EPERM), node test/mcp-schedule-wakeup.test.js (9 passed), git diff --check. Files changed: mcp-graph.js, lib/mcp-harness-tools.js, test/mcp-harness-tools.test.js, adapters/codex/README.md. Commit: 6453faa.
